ITEM 1 | Two long strips of cooked meat lying side by side, dark reddish-brown with crisp, charred-looking edges and glossy, slightly oily sheen; strips are about 1 cm wide and 12-14 cm long, with visible layered fat and lean streaks, slightly curled and flat, covering roughly a quarter of the plate on the left side | 25

ITEM 2 | Loose, soft scrambled egg pieces in pale yellow with some deeper golden patches and small darker flecks; crumbly clusters with irregular folds, no visible liquid pooling, mounded on the right half of the plate and spilling slightly toward the edge, about 4 cm tall in the thickest area and covering roughly a third of the plate | 85
